page.layout: One page: an engraved bookplate in the centre, with handwritten notes above it (not transcribed).
page.notes: The engraving is an ex-libris bookplate in a framed border. Above it are manuscript notes in ink, not printed, and so not transcribed. They read roughly "Vendu 14 Aout en 1887", "Illustrée 10 fr.", "C. as." and "Sumptibus Jo. de Serens ... sur un petit morceau d'ecrit", and are partly illegible. The line "Sumptibus" and the French words are uncertain.
